retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait layout featuring a dominant 3D block title at the top and a secondary sans-serif hierarchy on the right.

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast male portrait set against a dark, textured background, anchored by a large 3D extruded title at the top and right-aligned sans-serif text blocks.
coreVisualRelationships: Large 3D title spanning the top horizontal axis
Close-up portrait filling the lower two-thirds of the frame
Right-aligned text block balancing the subject's gaze
High-contrast lighting creating deep shadows on the subject's face
coreInvariants: 3D extruded block lettering for the primary title

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large-scale portrait positioned slightly off-center to the left, filling most of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The 3D block title at the top edge acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the bold title, moves down to the subject's eyes, then follows the gaze to the right-aligned text list.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space in the upper right and lower left corners provides breathing room for text and logos.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark charcoal background
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and off-white typography
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Light blue and red accents within the 3D title extrusion
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the bright, saturated title elements.

letterConstructionRules: Primary title uses thick, geometric sans-serif bases
3D extrusion is projected downwards and to the right
Secondary text uses a condensed, uniform-stroke sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Title letters feature a white face with a blue and red 3D block effect

treatment.depth: 3D block extrusion in blue and red

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy 3D display face paired with a clean, condensed sans-serif for information density.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy, condensed feel of the secondary text.
Provides the solid geometric base needed for the 3D title.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast, close-up portrait of a man with a mustache, lit from the side to create deep shadows, against a dark, textured black background. Leave the top 20% and right 30% of the frame relatively clear for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large 3D block title across the top in white with blue and red extrusion. Place a right-aligned block of condensed sans-serif text in the upper right quadrant. Add small rectangular and diamond logos in the bottom corners.

verificationChecks: Is the portrait high-contrast with deep shadows?
Is the background dark and textured?

adjustableVariables: Density of the right-aligned text list
mustRedesign: Avoid using specific artist names or song titles
Do not replicate the exact 'Hi Records' or 'London' logos
Ensure the portrait is a generic representation of the style
postGenerationChecks: Verify right-alignment of the tracklist-style text
Ensure the portrait lighting matches the moody soul aesthetic
Confirm the color palette is limited to the specified retro tones
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + 3D Block Title + Right-Aligned Condensed Sans-Serif + High Contrast Lighting = Vintage Soul Aesthetic
